snippet.title: DISCHARGE PENDING – Official Trailer | Psychological Horror Game
snippet.description:
DISCHARGE PENDING is a first-person psychological horror game where the only way out is down.

Free demo coming soon.

Learn more:
https://discharge-pending.com

Every floor looks the same. 
Until it doesn’t.

Study your surroundings. Spot the anomalies. Decide whether to go up or down. Make the wrong call and the hospital may never let you leave.

Developed by TAKO GAMES.

#DischargePending #HorrorGame #IndieGame
